waterAndSewerConnection.correctsEarlierAssumption: Superseded twice. The corridor does not start at Lot 1's WEST CORNER: it starts at the LOT 1 / LOT 12 / LOT 13 corner 39.46 ft south-east of it, on Lot 1's south-west line, and runs S 84-00-24 W. Anchoring it on the west corner put the run at whatever angle the nearest boundary vertex and the nearest centreline point happened to make, and it crossed LOT 15 — ground these lots have no right over. BOTH water and sewer come from Modupeola Way through this corridor; the earlier drawing tapped water in Rollins Avenue, which the record contradicts.
